VARIANT 02 — CINEMATIC DARK + AURORA — ANNOTATION KEY
Instrument Serif italic over soft radial aurora.
Cyan + purple bloom. Film grain top layer.
"Graphic Designer" in cyan italic serif at 2× the
developer label's weight. Sells the design half.
Backdrop-blur pill with tech-stack ticker. Diagonal
shimmer band drifts across. Halts for reduced-motion.
Cyan primary, ghost secondary. ≥48px. Dashed cyan
ring shows :focus-visible state — WCAG AA proof.
Existing spinning gear at 2× scale, halo + gear teeth,
dashed magnet ring shows pointer pull radius.
Card 2 shown hovered: magnet offset +4px, cyan
edge, shimmer band drifts. Card 1 + 3 at rest.
Halo near primary CTA. Disabled on coarse pointer
+ reduced-motion. No bottom nav on mobile.
Instrument Serif italic display · Manrope body · Geist Mono accent · soft radial aurora bloom + film grain ·
glass nav (scroll-shrinks with backdrop-blur) · glass cards w/ shimmer drift + magnetic offset on hover
· cyan accent · parallax orbs at 3 depths · cursor halo (fine pointer only) · visible focus ring · 16:9 project thumbs.
